title: larecipe:validate --json output
description: The report printed by php artisan larecipe:validate --json and returned by the validate_docs MCP tool. Every issue has a stable rule id and, where possible, a fix an agent can apply.

ok.description: False when there is at least one error.

rule.description: A stable id: links.broken, links.unsafe,navigation.missing-page, pages.orphan, manifest.schema, manifest.integrations, navigation.schema, frontmatter.schema, frontmatter.description.missing, components.unknown, components.props, snippets.missing, media.placeholder, pages.duplicate, pages.empty, redirects.loop, links.private-from-public, search.budget, markdown.size, skills.spec, cache.store.

page.description: The page, as {locale}/{version}/{path} with the default locale and an unversioned set's version left out.

file.description: The file the issue is in, relative to the set's root.
